Judge only whether the generated face remains clear relative to the source and its own first frame at later sampled times. Distinguish visible blur or distortion from legitimate head turns, hair occlusion and face leaving the crop due viewpoint. If later facial features are hidden or not comparable, answer uncertain rather than treating invisibility alone as detail loss. Name directly visible features and frame labels, including blur, ghosting or distortions when truly visible. Do not assess full-body action, background or camera angle. Return JSON {"late_face_detail_retained":"yes|no|uncertain","frame_evidence":"string","limits":"string"}.
